answer: A staked-identity gate resists sybil attacks by requiring every agent to lock capital before it can act or vote. Ten fake personas demand ten deposits, and any identity caught duplicating work has its stake slashed. Each sockpuppet raises the attacker's capital at risk while the marginal reward stays flat, so honest agents reach the summit of trust cheaply as sybils bleed from the first dawn. A public record of every slash denies the attacker the ledge of anonymity, so each restart costs them a fresh set of forged identities.
